pos.personaBrief: Cardoso wants to 'control the games' and 'not have ornamental possession'; Sundowns sit near 70% possession and build from the back, though he warns of facing less possession abroad.

pro.personaBrief: Sundowns build short from the back with a 3-2-5 or 2-2-4 and rotating midfielders, and he calls himself a 'romantic' coach, but he also used direct balls to Leon against FAR's press and prefers a few seconds of counter-press then reorganising.

est.personaBrief: Free-roaming midfielders (Modiba, Allende) rotating constantly, wingers/forwards dropping to link (Leon, Mathews), yet a clear morphing structure (3-2-5, rest defence).

lar.personaBrief: Wide fullbacks push high (Mudau, Modiba isolated wide, cutbacks), the team funnels play wide and uses a 3-2-5 with width, with an extra pivot inside.

blo.personaBrief: He wants aggression on losing the ball and a structured collective press, but uses a compact 4-4-2 mid-block against high-pressing sides and a deep 5-4-1 only late in games.

mar.personaBrief: No source states his marking scheme; offside trap and compact blocks suggest zonal organisation, though he limited Belaili as a specific threat.

pla.personaBrief: He insists his style fits Sundowns and sticks to his model of four moments, but tweaks shape per opponent (4-4-2 mid-block vs Esperance, back three/five late vs Al Ahly).

res.personaBrief: A self-described romantic who rejects the 'defensive' label, but closed finals and the Al Ahly tie with a back five to protect the lead.

sis.personaBrief: System-driven coach: structured four moments, heavy rotation with no fixed core, players 'selected by condition not status', and everyone must meet the collective demands.

jog.personaBrief: He praised the squad as technically well-developed and builds with technical midfielders like Allende and Modiba, while still demanding intensity in pressing and counter-pressing.

bas.personaBrief: Mixes young and experienced, promotes academy players like the 19-year-old defender, rotates by form and training, and does not build around the academy.

lid.personaBrief: A Bola describes him as an aggregating coach who rejects the authoritarian figure, values dialogue and empathy, but keeps demand, responsibility and meritocracy.
